origins.neoorigins.human.name: amdan
origins.neoorigins.human.description: yiwen wemdan ur yesɛi tazmert s wayes yesɛan tazmert, lameɛna yesɛan tazmert s wayes yesɛan tazmert.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Merlin
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: Imdanen n waman i d-ilulen di lebḥeṛ yeldin, țțawin-d aman iwakken ad sseɣlin s leḥnana, meɛna țɛeṭṭut, ffɣent ɣef lqaɛa yeffren.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Awiyen
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: D amdan n ṭṭmeɛ i d-yețțaken ṭṭmeɛ, ur țțaggad ara lqaɛa, ur yețɛassan ara ddunit seg igenwan.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Lɣella n tmes
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: Seg tmes n tmes i d-yufan, i d-ițwaxelqen s uqeṛṛuy, i d-ițțunefkent di ṭṭlam, ma d waman d waman i d-yessufɣen.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytryan
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: Yiwet n tmusni yeṣfan n ṭṭmeɛ, yesɛan azal seg igenni ; leɛmeṛ ur nesɛi azal, ur nezmir ara ad sɛu leslaḥ ɛlayen.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderyanik
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Ilul-ed di tegzirt ibeṛṛaniyen n tfeṛṛant n tfeṛṛant, ad ițwarfed, ad ileḥḥun di tlemmast n tlemmast n tmura, ad tebɛen di tegzirt n tmura, ad ițwaɛerḍen am lḥebs.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Araqnid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Imdanen n tiɛewwiɛin i gzemren i leswaṛ, iḍeggṛen iɛdawen-nsen, iɛewjen-nsen s ṭṭmeɛ ; iɛewdiwen n tmanya i d-iḥesben di ddunit.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Bulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: ?ef wannect-agi, m'ara d-yeɣli ṭṭmeɛ am ṭṭmeɛ, m'ara d-yeɣli ṭṭmeɛ, iɛdawen igenni s ṭṭmeɛ, țɛeggiḍen meɛna ur nezmir ara a t-yeɣli.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Fantus
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: Yiwet n tazmert i d-iqqimen deg yiḍ ɣef yiwet n tewwurt, yesɛan tazmert seg wemkan, lameɛna yesɛan yiṭij, ur izmir ad steɛfu.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: S waman yesɛan lǧil ɣer lǧil, ițwali s waman ur nesɛi taɣect.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: Imuqel-ed deg ṭṭlam. Tbeggneḍ-ed aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (ițwalin lǧehd K).
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Rrif dinna
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Mazal-ikkun tesɛam seg waman, aṭas n waman, aṭas n waman i d-tekkam. Ițwaɣeḍ, d aman, d aman, d aman, neɣ d aqṛuc n waman i gzedɣen, ṭṭfen-t kullec.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Ur d-yețțak ara lexbaṛ seg weɣḍas, d waḍu i d-iḍeggṛen.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: Aɣeṭṭas i geɣli
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Ilaq aț-țxedmem lfayda : ɛiwzet di tlemmast. Ur nesɛi lfayda. Walit : ?ef wannect-agi i gețwaɣeḍlen, ihi ḥadret iman-nwen iwakken aț-țkecmeḍ.
Lecɣal i gxeddmen 75% mazal aṭas n tezmert si mkul lecɣal.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Teẓriḍ
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Allen-ik tesɛiḍ, walit acḥal yelhan deg ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Aɣyul ifeṛṛqen
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 wul (-2 taxaṭer HP). Lǧețța tafat, lǧețța leɛqel.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: ?ess-iț
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Ɣuṛ-wat aț-țesɛuḍ deg igenni s ṭṭmeɛ, ur țțaggad ara laẓ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Times i d-yețțak times ɣer beṛṛa.
+3 ulawen (+6 tameqqrant HP). Lɣaci-nni n lǧețța sseǧhaden lǧețța.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: Sɛedda di lqaɛa ɣer lǧameɛ n wexxam, sɛedda tɛeǧbeḍ deg wexxam n Nefter (usem lmeṣnuɛat ur d-tețwali ara).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Sbeggneɣ ifassen-iw ɣef ddemma n wedɣaɣ iwakken ad ṛebḥeɣ azṛu, aseggas akk-d ssufɣen-iw mbla lbabuṛ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Tmes yesɛan lǧețțat yesɛan lǧețțat — laẓ tețfeǧǧiǧ 25%.
Aman yesɛan ccnaɛ, mkul sennig n waman neɣ m'ara d-yawi waman.
Allen-agi i d-ițwalin d infrared, walit ț-țideț di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (ițțusemman K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Tmes
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: ?uṛ-wat aqcic n tmes di teswiɛt i tețmuquleḍ, a t-yefk snat tazmert, ṛebɛa-nni tnefsit tmes.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: m'ara tfeǧǧeǧ s lǧețțat s lǧiha.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Urɛad yesɛi lfayda
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Ɣuṛ-wat aț-țesɛuḍem am yiwen n imezdaɣ n imezdaɣ n Elytra, ulac ayen i geḥwaǧen. Ɛiwzet, ɣeǧǧeḍ iwakken a d-iɣleḍ iɣaḍen-ik.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: ?ess-iț
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Ɣef wannect-agi i d-yețțak lexṣaṣ n lǧețțat n leǧwahi n lǧiha n lǧiha, ṭṭfen ɣer leɛṛuṛ mbla leḥsab.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Timwim n tneflit
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Ifṛax ṭṭmeɛ, snat iɣsan ur nesɛi azal.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Ur zmiren ara a d-issers llebsa taɛekkumt
Ur yezmir ara ad yeslusut azal, ddheb, ddheb neɣ ddnub ; ur yezmir ara ad yeslusu anagar llebsa d lḥebs ; ddnub ilaq ad qqimen tafat.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Stamped
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: ?erreḍ ɣef iḍaṛṛen iḍaɛen, ṛebɛa lǧehd, ṛebɛa-nni tnac.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Llant n wakal
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: ?eǧǧet lqaɛa s tnefsit ; ṛebɛa cceṛ akk-d Lɣeṛḥ II, ṛebɛa seguten i iɛdawen meṛṛa imezdaɣen di tlemmast n cinq-nni.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Ur țḥebbiṛet ara i wallen-ik, walit-asen mbla ccetkin.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% tazmert aț-țețrewleḍ, aț-țḍuɛem deg-s m'ara t-id-yewweḍ cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: mkul sennig, tețțawi-d snat n leḥwayeǧ seg waman neɣ d ugezṛuf.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Efka-d lḥal
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Tesɛiḍ ɣer wanda tețmuquleḍ – armi ț-țan 50 slatin, tnefsit-ed snat tazmert. 3-es senniḍen tmes.
M'ara ṭṭfeɛ ɣef kra n wuḍaṛ iɛerḍen, ṭṭfeɛ ɣef leḥwayeǧ iwakken ad ṭṭfeɛ, ad qqimen iwakken ad qqimen ɣer wemkan, m'ara ṭṭfeɛ cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Tețɛici seg wemkan n wemkan-agi ur țwaḥesben ara, tɣelṭen imiren kan.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Ɣef wannect-agi, ḥesben-t-id yiwen n lḥeqq i d-yețțak s lḥukuma n Bani n Artropod.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Melee ḥekkmen a t-id-yefk ṭṭmeɛ ; tlata senniḍen i ɣ-ițwaḥesben d ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Iḍeggeṛ yiwen wemkan-agi i d-yețțak iman-is, issers ayen akk i d-yețțak ; ițțak-ed snat tazmert.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Ur țțaggadeɣ ara deg-i dayem. Aɛekkaz-nni yesɛan lǧețța yesɛan azal.
Acḥal : serreḥ-ed iɛdawen i gzedɣen lmeṣnuɛat — iɛdawen i gzedɣen ț-țlata sennig ; ṛebɛin-d snat n tnac.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Tețbecciṛeț : tṛuḥeḍ ɣer tẓurin-ik, tuɣaleḍ-ed ɣer tɛecmatin n tmeddit.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Ɣef wannect-agi iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ lemɛawna ; aɛekkaz-nwen tețqellibem m'ara d-uɣalen d iɛekwan.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfeǧǧiǧ deg aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen, ur ilaq ara ad ițțunefken i dayem ɣef waman.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: ?effukk
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Ur tețțuɣalem ara aț-țeẓrem, aț-țuɣalem d ayen ur nesɛi lmeɛna.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Leḥṛam n lǧiha
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Ɣuṛ-wat aț-țesɛuḍem am yiwen n imezdaɣ n imezdaɣ n Elytra, ulac ayen i geḥwaǧen. Ɛiwzet, ɣeǧǧeḍ iwakken a d-iɣleḍ iɣaḍen-ik.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Ɣef wannect-agi, m'ara ṛuḥen ad ṭṭfen deg lfeṛḥ ; m'ara ṛuḥen ad ṭṭfen deg-sen, ṭṭmeɛ-nsen qqimen.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Agur
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Ad ḥadreɣ seddaw waggur (anagar iḍ ), leḥjab-agi n waggur ; tafat n wemkan-agi, tafat n wass, ḥemmleɣ ccwal-agi.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Neǧǧa-ines
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Sseḥlu 1 HP yal mazal aț-țessemneḍ yiwen wergaz yeddren.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Ur nezmir ara ad yeɛǧi lmeɛna
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Ur yeɣli ara cceṛ, ur d-yețțak ara lǧețțat n ṛṛuḥ.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Ceɛṭeṛ n ṭṭeq
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Sṭef amkan n tmes, teṭṭfem 1.5 cceṛ deg yimeslayen n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: ?effliq
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 ulawen (-4 taxaṭer HP). Lǧețța n ṭṭmeɛ i gella a t-iɣleb.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Neɣli mbla tugeț
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Ur tezmirem ara aț-țeṭṭes, iḍ d aderɣal-ik.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Feline
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: Yiwet n wemdan yesɛan azal iḍ s yiwet n tẓurin akk-d yiwet n tmes, iger-ed ɣef iḍaṛṛen-nsen, iqeṛben zdat iɛewdiwen akk-d ṭṭmeɛ, meɛna keṛhen-asen aman s tezmert n tẓurin.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Imezdaɣ n lḥisab, ur d-yeɣli ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfehmem ɣef tṭercicin n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Taylit
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: Tețfeǧǧiǧ 10% ifeṛḥen akteṛ n wemdan ameqqran.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: ?-țalwit n uqeṛṛeb
